audience: SMS marketing and customer-messaging teams that text subscriber lists with Tatango

useCases.title: Check who opted out before a send
useCases.text: List the phone numbers that unsubscribed from one list, and do not message them. List the subscribers of the same list to compare the counts.

useCases.title: Review the messages sent to a list
useCases.text: List the messages sent to one list, optionally within a UTC date range. Open one message to see its content, send time and delivery counts.

useCases.title: Check the messages waiting to go out
useCases.text: List the messages scheduled for one list that are not yet sent, optionally within a UTC date range.

useCases.title: Look up a subscriber and the list setup
useCases.text: Open one subscriber of a list to see its phone number, name, custom fields and tags. List the custom fields and the settings of the list.

useCases.title: Add a new subscriber to a list
useCases.text: Add a phone number to one list, with an optional name, email, birthdate and zip code. This changes the list.

useCases.title: Send an order notice by SMS
useCases.text: Send one SMS or MMS to one phone number, for example an order notice. SMS is limited to 160 characters. The text reaches a real person.
